Before you visit

Where do I find my tire size?

Look on the sidewall for a code such as 225/55R18. You can usually find the original recommended size on the driver’s door placard.

What does on-rim mean?

If your seasonal tires are already mounted on their own wheels, you need an on-rim swap. If you have loose tires, we mount them on wheels and balance them.

Does a tire quote include installation?

We supply and install tires. When you request a quote, tell us you want the installed total so you know which price to compare.

Do I need an appointment?

Call us to check availability and arrange your visit.

Planning a seasonal changeover?

Call us about switching to winters in October through December or switching back in March through May. Let us know if your set is already on wheels.
